dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregularly scalloped, light-blue perimeters forming complex 'O' and overlapping 'C' shapes across the dorsal-lateral surface, featuring sharp contrast gradients between the thin, jagged outer rings and the dark blue-black interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of high-intensity white pixel clusters localized along the upper dorsal ridge, appearing as specular reflections rather than pigmented skin features, with a low density of small, solid light-colored spots in the posterior region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent mid-body annuli form an irregular quadrilateral, while the central trio of annuli creates an obtuse scalene triangle oriented longitudinally.

other_distinctive_markers: A continuous, high-intensity white specular highlight extends along the dorsal curvature, delineating the physical boundary between the subject and the background.
